name: kbd
useFor: Use to show a keyboard shortcut beside an action or in a tooltip, and inside a field for a search key. Group keys with KbdGroup.
source: Not in Figma; drawn in the brand's data face
title: Kbd
description: A key: a square 20px cap with a 1px Stone line on Bone and the key in 12px DM Mono in 80% Forest. On Forest (a tooltip) its line turns Haze and its text Bone.
